_comment: Repository path-type tags for src/manifest_agent/checks/path_filters.py. `valid_types` lists every tag a check's `types`/`types_or` may reference (includes the cross-cutting `executable`/`text` tags identify applies to every regular file, see path_filters.py's `_path_tags`). `suffix_tags` maps a lowercase file suffix to the tag(s) it implies, mirroring pre-commit `identify`.
